title: Just Juice Exotic Fruits Guanabana, Lime on Ice Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: A deliciously sweet and tropical blend of creamy, exotic guanabana, aka soursop fruit, which carries notes of pineapple, strawberry and apple, given a tangy jolt from fresh limes and a cool finish. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend hits the sweet spot between flavour and cloud production and the nic salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter kits and pod devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts.
